niche: connected TV and streaming advertising agency
prompt_text: What is the best connected TV advertising agency?
answer_verbatim:
Short answer: there is no single “best” CTV advertising agency — the right partner depends on your goals (brand awareness vs performance), budget, markets, platforms you want to reach, and whether you need creative, data/attribution, or just media buying.

If you want a quick recommendation tailored to you, tell me:
- Geography (US, EMEA, APAC, etc.)
- Budget and campaign length
- Primary goal (awareness, direct-response, lead gen, ROAS)
- Need for creative production vs. media buying only
- Any must-have inventory (Roku, Hulu, Samsung TV Plus, etc.)
- Measurement/attribution requirements (incremental reach, sales lift, MMPs)

Meanwhile, here’s a practical way to evaluate agencies and a few types of partners to consider.

How to choose a “best” CTV partner (key criteria)
- Platform relationships and inventory access (direct deals with Roku, Hulu, Samsung, Amazon Fire TV, publishers)
- Programmatic expertise and DSP access (The Trade Desk, DV360, owners’ platforms)
- Creative & dynamic ad capabilities for CTV (innovative creative formats, interactive overlays, personalized ads)
- Measurement & attribution (SMPs, ACR partners like Samba TV, incrementality studies, conversion linking)
- Reporting transparency (impressions, viewability, completion rates, CPMs, fraud prevention)
- Case studies in your industry and references
- Pricing model and fee transparency (percent of media, flat fee, performance-based)
- Data & targeting (first‑party data, identity solutions, privacy-compliant targeting)

Types of partners and when to use them
- Large holding-group media agencies (WPP/GroupM, Omnicom, Publicis, IPG, Dentsu): best if you need global scale, TV+digital integration, and full-service planning.
- Independent/digital-first media agencies: better for nimble, performance-oriented CTV campaigns and often more transparent fees.
- CTV-specialist platforms & managed-service partners (Roku Ads/OneView, The Trade Desk, FreeWheel, Tremor Video, MNTN): great when you want deep technical/platform expertise and access to owner/first‑party inventory.
- Creative & measurement specialists (Innovid, Samba TV, TVSquared): use alongside media buyers if you need advanced creative or measurement.

Examples of vendors commonly used (not exhaustive)
- Programmatic/Platforms: The Trade Desk, Roku Ads, DV360, FreeWheel, Magnite/Tremor
- CTV-focused ad tech/creative: Innovid, Amobee, MNTN
- Measurement/attribution: Samba TV, TVSquared, Google Campaign Manager / DV360 integrations

Next steps I can help with
- Build a 3–5 agency shortlist matched to your needs
- Draft an RFP template for CTV partners
- Create evaluation questions and a scoring rubric for proposals

Tell me the details above (market, budget, goals, creative needs) and I’ll recommend a tailored shortlist.
